result.summary: The interface displays minor visual inconsistencies in layout and content quality across different restaurant sections.

issues.description: Delivery information is displayed inconsistently between the carousel and the list views.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the placement of delivery fees and time badges across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Generic placeholder illustrations are used instead of actual merchant food photography.
issues.suggestion: Update cards with high-quality, realistic images to improve visual appeal.

issues.description: The delivery fee text in the 'Fastest near you' section has low contrast and small font size.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font size and contrast to improve readability for secondary information.
